Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly interpreted the `datePublished` metadata field from the IMDb page (which indicates when the webpage was published, 2019-02-28) as the film's release date. More critically, the Planner combined this date with the film's title year "1991" to fabricate a release date of "1991-02-28". This is a logical error because the film is a 2019 production, and the year "1991" in the title refers to the story's setting, not the release year. This fabrication led to the incorrect conclusion that *Dilan 1991* (allegedly 1991) came out before *Celine: Through The Eyes Of The World* (2010), whereas in reality, both films were released in 2010 and 2019 respectively (with *Celine* being the earlier of the two). The WebSurfer correctly identified the IMDb date as 2019-02-28 in the JSON metadata, but the Planner failed to recognize the discrepancy and made a false deduction.
